rationale.consistency: trimPathSuffix mirrors trimPathPrefix in naming, structure, comment style and EqualFold/PathUnescape usage; error comment copied verbatim.
rationale.edge_cases: Required cases pass, but only the last hex digit of a suffix escape is forced literal: suffix %2f wrongly matches path ...%252f (and %25%32f), diverging from the prefix semantics.
rationale.scope: One-line call-site change, new helper, removal of the now-unused reverse(); nothing else touched.
rationale.readability: Clear backward lock-step loop with good comments, though the 'byte for byte' comment overstates what the suffixEscaped check enforces.
rationale.robustness: Index bounds guarded (iPath>=3, iSuffix>=3), PathUnescape error handled, empty suffix after placeholder expansion is a safe no-op.
rationale.maintainability: Symmetric with the prefix helper so easy to follow; the escape-detection asymmetry is a latent trap for future edits.
